discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch — narrowed the union rather than filtering raw IDs. `acpListProviderModels` now unions the live list only for providers whose supported-models endpoint returns exclusively agent-usable models: ACP agent adapters (`category === 'agent'`, generic across current/future adapters) and the first-party Anthropic API (allowlisted; its `/v1/models` is all chat/tool-capable). Other model providers (OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, …) keep the canonical-filtered inventory list, so embeddings/audio/image models no longer leak into the picker. Added tests for both the agent-category union and the non-allowlisted no-union case (which also asserts live discovery is skipped entirely).

**Fixed in 75cb3e1.** Good catch. Now using `lastMessageAt ?? updatedAt` for both the per-project session sort and the group-level sort, so metadata-only updates (renames) don't reorder sessions above active chats. Added a test case covering this in the same commit.

Fixed in b1269ebefb82494986fc310278b5d26ed1738325. The ACP server emits incremental text deltas the same way the legacy stream does (each `AgentEvent::Message` text chunk for a given message id is appended, not cumulative), so the `mergeTextChunk` dedup heuristics were wrong. Replaced with a plain `+=` append to match `useChatStream.pushMessage`, and added a regression test for the `Hel`+`l` case.
